name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge to get three recipe recommendations based on your ingredients.
problem: Deciding what to cook with available ingredients in the fridge can be difficult and lead to food waste.
audience: Home cooks looking to prepare meals using ingredients they already have.

features.name: Fridge Ingredient Detection
features.description: Captures a photo of an open fridge and automatically detects visible ingredients.

features.name: Recipe Recommendations
features.description: Provides three recipes ranked by how many of your detected ingredients they use.

features.name: Missing Ingredients Shopping List
features.description: Generates a shopping list for the missing items needed to make suggested recipes.

flow.text: Tap the camera button to open the camera view.
Take a photo of the open fridge.
View detected ingredients identified from the photo.
Review three recipe suggestions ranked by matching ingredients.
Check the shopping list for any missing items needed for the recipes.
